supersedes: v5 全员 purple-black + red accents 单一配色
proportion: compact 3.2-3.5 heads (以已通过的 v5 style gate 为准，非旧 spec 的 4.5 头身)

shared_style.outline: rough uneven black ink outline, scratchy internal lines
shared_style.shading: flat two-step cel shading, no gradient, no airbrush

bases.body: compact standard adult male, moderate shoulders, low center of gravity
bases.note: 现有 male_base 网格不重出；仅在 Blender 里按角色重烘焙底衣颜色

bases.body: compact heavy-set adult male, broad thick shoulders, thick neck, barrel chest, heavier thighs; same head size and same overall height as male_standard
bases.build_constraint: Only the girth of the torso and limbs changes. Total height, head-to-body ratio, shoulder joint height, elbow, wrist, hip, knee and ankle positions must stay identical to the reference base.
bases.note: 只加厚躯干与四肢围度，不改身高、头身比和骨骼关节位置

bases.body: compact standard adult female, moderate shoulders, defined waist
bases.note: 现有 female_base 网格不重出；仅在 Blender 里按角色重烘焙底衣颜色

bases.body: compact lean adult female, narrower shoulders, slimmer limbs, wiry build; same head size and same overall height as female_standard
bases.build_constraint: Only the girth of the torso and limbs changes. Total height, head-to-body ratio, shoulder joint height, elbow, wrist, hip, knee and ankle positions must stay identical to the reference base.
bases.note: 只收窄围度，不改身高、头身比和骨骼关节位置

base_undersuit_source.target: neutral dark charcoal gray #33323A, deliberately desaturated
base_undersuit_source.reason: 底衣是可染色源图。新基体直接出中性灰；两套现有紫黑基体在 Blender 里先去饱和再乘目标色，两条路径得到一致结果。

class_motifs.medic: plain geometric cross (not a letter or typographic glyph)
class_motifs.demolition: hazard stripes and a triangular blast mark

class_parts.gunner: head with hair, thickened tactical gloves, cross-body ammo belt, compact ammunition chest rig, hip magazine pouches, knee pads
class_parts.assault: head with hair, medium chest rig, elbow guards, belt magazine pouches, knee pads, identifier arm band
class_parts.medic: head with hair and headlamp band, short medical shoulder cape, cross-body medical satchel, bandage pouches, elbow guards, waist kit, knee pads
class_parts.demolition: head with hair and goggles pushed up on the forehead, reinforced shoulder pads, tool chest rig, demolition waist kit, thigh mine pouch, knee pads
class_parts.riot: riot helmet with raised visor, broad shoulder armor, forearm guards, thick chest armor, compact back plate, belt pouches, knee guards

class_silhouette.gunner: the horizontal ammo belt is the loudest element; the widest point of the upper body is at the chest
class_silhouette.assault: lightest kit of the roster; medium chest rig and elbow guards, with the identifier band high on the upper arm
class_silhouette.medic: softest shoulder line; short cape hem and a cross-body satchel, and the only kit with a headlamp
class_silhouette.demolition: tallest and widest shoulder pads, with heavy thigh hangers pulling down and mass clearly biased upward
class_silhouette.riot: squarest and thickest overall; the helmet closes off the top of the head and the forearm guards are the largest in the roster
